skill.name: blocklet-updater
skill.description: Automates Blocklet release preparation by selecting a version bump method, checking changelog entries, building assets, verifying metadata, and creating a release bundle.
skill.summary: Prepare and bundle Blocklet releases with version, changelog, build, and metadata checks.
skill.author: ArcBlock

security_audit.summary: The skill performs legitimate Blocklet release automation, but it requires running local release, build, and bundling commands. Most static alerts are markdown backtick or local file-inspection false positives; the confirmed risks are expected external command execution and dependency/build script execution in the target repository.

remediation.issue: Project-defined version commands are executed during release preparation.
remediation.suggestion: Ask for user confirmation before running Makefile, package.json, lerna, or blocklet version commands, and show the selected command first.

remediation.issue: The build step can execute dependency lifecycle scripts and project build code.
remediation.suggestion: Run builds only in trusted repositories and avoid automatic execution when package changes are unreviewed.

remediation.issue: Release bundling modifies or creates project artifacts.
remediation.suggestion: Report changed files before final bundling and require explicit approval for publishing or sharing the generated release.

content.value_statement: Blocklet releases require careful version, changelog, build, and bundle steps. This skill guides Claude, Codex, or Claude Code through a repeatable release workflow.
actual_capabilities: Detects the preferred version bump command from Makefile, package.json, lerna, or Blocklet tooling.
Checks the resulting version in blocklet.yml or package.json.
Validates and updates CHANGELOG entries when they are missing or mismatched.
Runs project build steps when a package build script exists.
Verifies the Blocklet entry point and blocklet.yml main field.
Runs Blocklet metadata validation and creates a release bundle.
limitations: Requires Blocklet and package tooling to be installed in the local environment.
Runs local project scripts, so it should only be used in trusted repositories.
Does not publish the release artifact to a remote registry.
May need user input when changelog content cannot be inferred from commits.

use_cases.title: Prepare a routine Blocklet release
use_cases.description: Bump the project version, verify metadata, and create a release bundle using the project workflow.

use_cases.title: Repair release metadata before bundling
use_cases.description: Check changelog versions, entry points, and blocklet.yml settings before creating the bundle.

use_cases.title: Standardize monorepo release steps
use_cases.description: Choose the right version command and changelog location across Blocklet packages.

prompt_templates.title: Create a basic Blocklet release
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a new release for this Blocklet project. Show me the command you will run before executing project scripts.

prompt_templates.title: Bump and bundle after review
prompt_templates.prompt: Bump the Blocklet version, verify the changelog, run the build if needed, and create a release bundle.

prompt_templates.title: Fix release metadata first
prompt_templates.prompt: Check blocklet.yml, the build output directory, and the changelog before bundling this Blocklet release.

prompt_templates.title: Handle a monorepo release
prompt_templates.prompt: Detect the correct version workflow in this monorepo, update the relevant changelog, build the package, and create the Blocklet release bundle.

output_examples.output: The assistant detects the project version command, runs the release checks, validates metadata, and creates a bundle when all checks pass.

output_examples.input: The changelog version does not match the new package version.
output_examples.output: The assistant identifies the mismatch, updates the latest changelog heading, checks for entry content, and continues only after the changelog is valid.

output_examples.input: Bundle this Blocklet after building it.
output_examples.output: The assistant installs dependencies, runs the build script, verifies the generated index.html location, and creates the release bundle.

best_practices: Review the selected version command before letting the skill run it.
Use the skill from a clean working tree so release changes are easy to inspect.
Confirm changelog content before creating the final bundle.
anti_patterns: Do not run this skill in an untrusted repository without reviewing scripts first.
Do not use it to publish artifacts without a separate approval step.
Do not ignore build or metadata validation failures.

faq.question: Does this skill publish the Blocklet release?
faq.answer: No. It creates a release bundle but does not publish it to a remote registry.

faq.question: Can it work with custom version scripts?
faq.answer: Yes. It checks Makefile and package.json scripts before using default Blocklet version commands.

faq.question: Does it update CHANGELOG.md?
faq.answer: Yes, when a changelog exists and the latest entry is missing, empty, or has the wrong version.

faq.question: What tools must be installed?
faq.answer: The project environment needs the relevant package manager, Blocklet tooling, and any project-specific release tools.

faq.question: Is it safe for untrusted repositories?
faq.answer: No. It can run local project scripts, so review repository scripts before execution.

faq.question: Can Claude Code use this skill?
faq.answer: Yes. The metadata lists Claude, Codex, and Claude Code as supported tools.
